Metadata.Title: Spyro Reignited Trilogy
Metadata.Name: 1620p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 3840x2160 output with 2880x1620 render in PS4 Pro (NEO) mode (the game renders 2560x1440 into a 1920x1080 output by default). Needs 2160p video output. Enable only one resolution entry. Requires NEO Enabler.
Metadata.Author: Shane O'Reilly
